litematica-creator.config.generic.commen: Allows Litematica Creator to consume edit inputs and maintain a client-side schematic draft.
Maximum distance in blocks for Creator projection targeting and editing.
Allows fixed-distance projection placement when no real or projection block is hit.
Fixed camera distance for placing a projection when no real or projection block is hit. Limited by Creator Edit Range.
Interval between repeated projection placements while the use key is held, in client ticks.
Interval between repeated projection deletions while the attack key is held, in client ticks.
Movement speed multiplier for the Creator Camera while using ground physics.
Movement speed multiplier for the Creator Camera while flying.
Automatically enables the Creator Camera when Creator mode is enabled. The separate camera hotkey remains available when disabled.
Automatically disables the Creator Camera when Creator mode is disabled. Turn this off to keep the camera active after leaving Creator mode.
Collides the Creator Camera with visible projection block shapes while it is in ground mode.
Allows projection blocks to be placed inside the camera avatar, the real player body, or other placement-blocking entities while the Creator Camera is active.
Writes extra Litematica Creator diagnostics to the game log.
Hides Litematica placement subregion boxes while Creator mode is active.
Opens the virtual Creator inventory instead of the real inventory when the inventory key is pressed in Creator mode.
Also selects a newly created blank placement in Litematica's native placement manager.
